reported_context.claim_paraphrase: ANA reports that the station level remained above the flood stage for 30 days between 2 May and 1 June 2024.

interpretation_limits: This is an agency-published narrative about a point gauge, not the primary timestamped gauge series.
It provides date-range chronology, not readings at the SAR acquisition times.
The station is near, but outside, the SAR AOI; it is not a measurement of water extent within SAR pixels.
The statement provides event context only and does not identify the cause of the SAR backscatter response or resolve RTC-S1 product QA.
